selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Pre- and post-restart checks show RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64.

Healthy baseline boot ID a8e7c48c-f025-4f14-9fd0-ef6c37642e45 was captured; the reboot was scheduled, node1 became unavailable, then returned with changed boot ID e073e12a-23c7-4731-a207-c90881b01e9c. The system recovered to running with no failed units, the filesystem remained read-write, all hashes and inode relationships passed, and reboot history confirms the boot.
